verdict.rationale: Cua documents a public programmatic surface. The Cua SDK lets you "create and drive computers from your own code" in Python, TypeScript and Rust, and Cua Driver exposes control through MCP or a CLI, with machine-readable docs (llms.txt, docs.md) live. A hands-on report of the Computer API Server WebSocket failing to connect on an old cua-agent version (0.1.29) points to reliability trouble, not a missing API, so it lowers quality rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: a published OpenAPI/REST spec (all probed paths 404), in-depth API reference evidence beyond summary pages, and independent confirmation that the current API works reliably.
